title: Passive Voice: was/were + Past Participle
grammarTitle: Passive Voice — Forming and Using the Passive
grammarNote: Страдательный залог (passive voice) используется, когда действие важнее того, кто его совершает. Структура: TO BE (в нужном времени) + PAST PARTICIPLE (3-я форма глагола). Если нужно указать исполнителя — добавляем BY + агент. В Present Simple: am/is/are + pp. В Past Simple: was/were + pp.

grammarTable.subject: Present Simple
grammarTable.example: "The milk is produced on local farms." / "Products are inspected daily."

grammarTable.subject: Past Simple
grammarTable.example: "The building was designed in 1955." / "The students were told about it."

grammarTable.subject: Present Perfect
grammarTable.example: "Your application has been received." / "The error has been fixed."

grammarTable.subject: Future (will)
grammarTable.example: "The results will be announced tomorrow." / "You will be contacted soon."

grammarTable.subject: Modal
grammarTable.example: "It can be done." / "It must be checked." / "It should be approved."

grammarTable.subject: With BY
grammarTable.example: "The letter was written by Kamila." / "It was built by a local company."

grammarExtra.title: How to form the passive: step by step

rows.form: Step 1: find the object of the active
rows.example: "Workers built the bridge." → "the bridge" (object) becomes the new subject.

rows.form: Step 2: choose the right form of "be"

rows.example: "The bridge was built by local workers." (agent = who did it)
"The exam is marked by the professor." / "The products are checked every day."
"The exam was marked yesterday." / "The city was founded in 1850."
"Your essay has been received." / "The results have been published."
"The test will be given next week." / "You will be informed."
"The problem can be solved." / "This must be reported." / "It should be checked."

grammarExtra.title: When to use passive (and when not to)

rows.example: "The window was broken." (we don't know who did it)
"The president was elected." (everyone knows it's voters)
"The vaccine was developed in 2020." (the development matters, not exactly who)

rows.form: AVOID when: actor is clear and important
rows.example: ✗ "The essay was written by me." → ✅ "I wrote the essay." (active is clearer)
✅ "The book was WRITTEN by her." — must use past participle, not base form!
✅ "The car was BROKEN." (past) or "The car IS BROKEN." (state adjective)
✅ "It was BUILT." — irregular past participles! (build → built, not builded)
✅ "She is known by everyone." — actually correct! "known" = past participle of "know".

grammarTip:
Страдательный залог — формула:
TO BE (нужное время) + PAST PARTICIPLE

Present: am/is/are + pp
"It is made." / "They are produced."

Past: was/were + pp
"It was made." / "They were produced."

Perfect: has/have been + pp
"It has been made."

Future: will be + pp
"It will be made."

+ BY + агент (если нужно):
"It was built BY students."

⚠️ Частые нарушения:
✗ was write → ✅ was written
✗ was builded → ✅ was built
✗ is maked → ✅ is made
Всегда используй 3-ю форму (past participle)!

exercises.hint: Past passive = "was/were + past participle". "The bridge WAS BUILT in 1978." ✅

exercises.instruction: Complete with the correct passive form.
exercises.text: "The products ___ every morning." (check — present simple passive)
exercises.hint: Present passive: am/is/ARE + past participle. "The products ARE CHECKED every morning." ✅
"Workers designed..." = past active → "The bridge WAS DESIGNED by workers." ✅

exercises.text: "The car was drove by him." is a correct passive sentence.
exercises.hint: ✅ "The car was DRIVEN by him." — "drive" → irregular past participle = "driven". Not "drove"!
Present perfect passive: has/have + been + pp. "Your application HAS BEEN RECEIVED." ✅
Future passive: will + be + pp. "The results WILL BE ANNOUNCED tomorrow." ✅

exercises.instruction: Which sentence uses the passive correctly?
exercises.hint: "was WRITTEN" = correct past passive. Past participle of "write" = "written". ✅
"They built..." = past active → "This mosque WAS BUILT in 1850." ✅ (No need to add "by them" — agent is obvious/unimportant)
Modal passive: modal + be + pp. "The problem CAN BE SOLVED easily." ✅

exercises.text: "The essay was written by me." OR "I wrote the essay."
opts: "The essay was written by me." — passive is better
"I wrote the essay." — active is clearer when speaker is the agent
exercises.correct: "I wrote the essay." — active is clearer when speaker is the agent
exercises.hint: When the agent is important and obvious (you!), active is better. "I wrote the essay." ✅ is more natural.

exercises.text: "Three people ___ in the accident." (injure — past simple passive)
exercises.hint: "Three people" = plural → "WERE INJURED." Past passive plural. ✅

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct passive with BY.
exercises.hint: "The theory WAS PROPOSED BY Darwin." ✅ — past passive + by + agent.

questions.text: The passive voice is formed with:
questions.hint: Passive = TO BE (correct tense) + PAST PARTICIPLE. "is built", "was made", "has been approved".

questions.text: "The building was designed in 1955." This is:
questions.hint: "WAS designed" = was/were + past participle = past simple passive. ✅

questions.text: "The data ___ every week." (process — present simple passive)
questions.hint: Present passive: "The data IS PROCESSED every week." (data = singular → "is") ✅
"was developed" = past simple passive. ✅ Correct tense for 2020.

questions.text: "Your essay has been received." — What tense?
questions.hint: "HAS BEEN received" = has/have + been + past participle = present perfect passive. ✅

questions.text: "The results will be announced tomorrow." — What form?
questions.hint: "WILL BE announced" = future passive = will + be + past participle. ✅

questions.text: "The problem can be solved." — "Can be solved" uses:
questions.hint: Modal passive: modal + BE + past participle. "Can BE SOLVED." ✅
"was WRITTEN" — past passive. Past participle of "write" = "written". ✅ Never "was wrote"!

questions.text: When is passive voice most appropriate?
opts: When the agent is important and known
When the action or result is more important than who did it
questions.correct: When the action or result is more important than who did it
questions.hint: Passive is best when the action matters more than the actor — or when the actor is unknown.

questions.text: "The building was builded in 1978." — What is wrong?
questions.hint: ✅ "build" → past participle = "built". "The building WAS BUILT in 1978." — never "builded"!

questions.text: "Three students ___ (tell) about the exam." (past passive, plural)
questions.hint: Plural subject → "WERE told." Past passive. "tell" → past participle = "told". ✅

questions.text: "Mistakes were made." — What is NOT stated?
questions.hint: The agent (who made the mistakes) is not stated. This is the "invisible agent" — often intentionally omitted!

questions.text: How do you add the agent in a passive sentence?
questions.hint: "The cake was baked BY Kamila." — Always "BY" + agent. ✅
Future passive: "will be + past participle". "The application WILL BE PROCESSED within two weeks." ✅

questions.text: "The bridge was built." — Active voice equivalent:
questions.hint: "The bridge was built." → "Someone/They BUILT the bridge." (active equivalent — agent unknown so we say "someone")
